ordering_rule: Centroid is self. Two individually load-bearing orgs (birth machine swarm, birth swarm project) get their own piece each. The remaining 14 real orgs are folded into 3 thematic groups by real function, not by a mechanical sort -- see 'groups' for exact membership. The 9 leftover pieces are explicitly 'reserved', not filled with invented content, so future real org memberships have somewhere to land without forcing another restructure.
